// #region DEBUG
package PACKAGE

import (
 "bufio"
 "encoding/binary"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "strconv"
 "sync"
 "time"
)

const researchLimit = 600000
var researchTrace = struct {
 sync.Mutex
 path string
 rows [][10]uint64
 omitted uint64
}{path: os.Getenv("WS_STALL_TRACE") + ".PACKAGE.ndjson"}

func researchRecord(kind uint64, values ...uint64) {
 if os.Getenv("WS_STALL_TRACE") == "" { return }
 row := [10]uint64{uint64(time.Now().UnixMicro()), kind}
 copy(row[2:], values)
 researchTrace.Lock()
 if researchTrace.rows == nil { researchTrace.rows = make([][10]uint64, 0, researchLimit) }
 if len(researchTrace.rows) < researchLimit { researchTrace.rows = append(researchTrace.rows, row) } else { researchTrace.omitted++ }
 researchTrace.Unlock()
}
func researchFlush() {
 researchTrace.Lock()
 defer researchTrace.Unlock()
 if len(researchTrace.rows) == 0 { return }
 file, err := os.OpenFile(researchTrace.path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0600)
 if err != nil { return }
 writer := bufio.NewWriterSize(file, 1024*1024)
 encoder := json.NewEncoder(writer)
 _ = encoder.Encode(map[string]any{"debug":"[DEBUG H1 H2 H3 H4]", "package":"PACKAGE", "rows":len(researchTrace.rows), "omitted":researchTrace.omitted})
 for _, row := range researchTrace.rows { _ = encoder.Encode(row) }
 _ = writer.Flush()
 _ = file.Close()
 researchTrace.rows = researchTrace.rows[:0]
 researchTrace.omitted = 0
}
func researchPacket(kind uint64, epoch uint16, sequence uint64, raw []byte) {
 for offset := 12; offset+4 <= len(raw); {
  chunk := raw[offset:]
  size := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(chunk[2:4]))
  if size < 4 || size > len(chunk) { return }
  var tsn, extra uint64
  if size >= 8 { tsn = uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(chunk[4:8])) }
  if size >= 12 { extra = uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(chunk[8:12])) }
  researchRecord(kind, uint64(epoch), sequence, uint64(chunk[0]), tsn, uint64(chunk[1]), uint64(size), extra)
  if chunk[0] == 3 && size >= 16 {
   gaps := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(chunk[12:14]))
   for index := 0; index < gaps && 20+index*4 <= size; index++ {
    start := 16+index*4
    researchRecord(3, uint64(epoch), sequence, tsn, uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(chunk[start:start+2])), uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(chunk[start+2:start+4])))
   }
  }
  offset += (size+3)&^3
 }
}
var researchDropAt, _ = strconv.ParseUint(os.Getenv("WS_STALL_DROP_AT"),10,64)
var researchDropTSN uint32
var researchDropRemaining = 2
var researchDataCount uint64
var researchHighestTSN uint32
var researchHaveTSN bool
var researchDropRecords = make(map[uint64]bool)
func researchPlanDrop(epoch uint16, sequence uint64, raw []byte) {
 if researchDropAt == 0 || epoch != 1 { return }
 for offset:=12; offset+8<=len(raw); {
  chunk:=raw[offset:]; size:=int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(chunk[2:4]))
  if size<4 || size>len(chunk) {return}
  if (chunk[0]==0 || chunk[0]==64) && size>1000 {
   tsn:=binary.BigEndian.Uint32(chunk[4:8])
   if !researchHaveTSN || int32(tsn-researchHighestTSN)>0 {
    researchHaveTSN=true;researchHighestTSN=tsn;researchDataCount++
    if researchDataCount==researchDropAt {researchDropTSN=tsn}
   }
   if researchDataCount>=researchDropAt && tsn==researchDropTSN && researchDropRemaining>0 {
    researchDropRemaining--;researchDropRecords[sequence]=true
   }
  }
  offset+=(size+3)&^3
 }
}
func researchDropWire(raw []byte) bool {
 if researchDropAt==0 || len(raw)<13 {return false}
 var sequence uint64;for _,b:=range raw[5:11] {sequence=sequence<<8|uint64(b)}
 if !researchDropRecords[sequence] {return false}
 delete(researchDropRecords,sequence)
 researchRecord(5,1,sequence,uint64(researchDropTSN))
 return true
}
// #endregion DEBUG
